column1: # Plan D - AWS Graviton (m7g). Full range, NO cap: this box exists to cover
# all 598 ASIMD radix sets that the Pi cannot reach in reasonable time.
# Thread-heavy by design: ARMv8 is weakly ordered and Neoverse is aggressively
# out-of-order, so high thread counts are the point, not a side dimension.
# thread-scaling ladder at the baseline config, to localise any thread-count
# dependence to a specific degree of concurrency
# scalar oracle: isolates ARM-SIMD from ARM-general, and must match x86 nosimd
